name: graphysdk
description: Agent skills for integrating Graphy SDK packages

plugins.name: graphy
plugins.description: Build graphs with the Graphy SDK (@graphysdk/viz-engine + @graphysdk/react-renderer), install or set it up in a React codebase, and make Graphy charts editable — commands, undo/redo, annotations, the optional editor panel. Activates on requests to author Graphy graphs, to install, configure or fix a Graphy install, or to embed or drive Graphy's chart editing.
